card.name: Scattered words before a quantity or noun
card.fires_on: No single word or setting. It fires on varied ordinary words in general web prose, such as a comma after 'Right now', 'lawsuit', 'meeting', 'surely' or 'lent'.

modes.label: Just before a number
modes.description: A comma or word right before a stated count, such as '7 billion'.
modes.example: "Right now<<,>> there are 7 billion humans living on

modes.label: Mid-clause filler words
modes.description: Ordinary verbs, nouns or pronouns inside a sentence, with no shared theme.
modes.example: That book which you<< lent>> me is really good.

card.writes: It promotes number words like seven, nine and eleven and suppresses Chinese words for 'some' or 'certain', which suggests a push toward a specific count over a vague one.
card.plain: It fires on mixed everyday words and seems to nudge the model toward a specific number rather than a vague 'some'.
